reviewers.catalog_requirement: one statistics reviewer who re-derives the variance band from the raw per-run numbers, not from the summary

reviewers.method: Unbounded k=n injection on the ambiguous query must exceed the 500-token ceiling at 500 installed capabilities and grow near-linearly; top-k must hold the ceiling and stay sublinear.

legacy_root.measurement_notes: A single-point measurement cannot show flooding; the curve uses three catalogue sizes. Variance is stored as raw per-run integer token counts so a statistics reviewer can re-derive the band. cloud ok=true is not delivery.
